caption: Harbour, Goes
composition: Stadshaven quay and the distant crossing tower of the Grote Kerk · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The stadshaven at Goes is a still basin with brick quay walls and a few moored boats. Behind the roofs, the stone crossing tower of the Grote of Maria Magdalenakerk rises. The church itself stands inland, not in the water. The sky is mainly clear, about 16.8°C, with wind near 10.4 km/h. This is not the town hall on the market.
